children: Binance Wallet announced on X that, following the security incident involving the Nesa (NES) token contract, Binance Alpha 2.0 will support a NES contract swap on BNB Smart Chain (BEP20) and will apply an arrangement for eligible users. The update covers users on Binance Alpha who held NES before 2026-08-24 14:51 UTC, when deposits and withdrawals were closed. These users will receive a 1:1 token contract swap for the eligible portion of their NES holdings remaining at 2026-09-05 04:00 UTC, when trading was halted. NES acquired after 2026-08-24 14:51 UTC will not be included in the swap and will be refunded separately. Users with net-bought positions in NES between 2026-08-24 14:51 UTC and 2026-09-05 04:00 UTC will receive a direct email with details on their eligible refund within 7 working days.

Trading for Nesa (NES) on Binance Alpha 2.0 is expected to resume on 2026-09-10 at 08:00 UTC. The announcement did not provide additional details beyond the swap arrangement, refund process, and the planned trading resumption time.

title: Binance Alpha 2.0 to Support Nesa (NES) Contract Swap on BNB Smart Chain
